arguments.command:
python -c "
import semver

# Test R1: immutability (properties)
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
try:
    v.major = 2
    print('R1 FAIL: major was mutable')
except AttributeError:
    print('R1 PASS: major is immutable')

# Test R2: iteration
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
result = list(v)
print(f'R2: {result}')
assert result == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'], 'R2 FAIL'
print('R2 PASS')

# Test R3: tuple comparison
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f'R3: v < (1, 2, 4) = {v < (1, 2, 4)}')
print(f'R3: v > (1, 2, 2) = {v > (1, 2, 2)}')
print(f'R3: v == (1, 2, 3) = {v == (1, 2, 3)}')
try:
    v == '1.2.3'
    print('R3 FAIL: string comparison should fail')
except TypeError:
    print('R3 PASS: string comparison raises TypeError')

# Test R4: bump methods
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f'R4 bump_major: {v.bump_major()}')
print(f'R4 bump_minor: {v.bump_minor()}')
print(f'R4 bump_patch: {v.bump_patch()}')
v_pre = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'rc.1')
print(f'R4 bump_prerelease: {v_pre.bump_prerelease()}')
v_build = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, build='1')
print(f'R4 bump_build: {v_build.bump_build()}')
print('R4 PASS')

# Test R5: type enforcement
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, None, None)
print(f'R5 prerelease={v.prerelease!r}, build={v.build!r}')
print('R5 PASS')

# Test R6: CLI functions
print(f'R6 createparser: {semver.createparser is not None}')
print(f'R6 main: {semver.main is not None}')
print(f'R6 process: {semver.process is not None}')
print('R6 PASS')

# Test R7: replace function and method
new_ver = semver.replace('1.2.3', minor=5)
print(f'R7 module replace: {new_ver}')
vi = semver.VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3')
new_vi = vi.replace(minor=5, patch=9)
print(f'R7 method replace: {new_vi}')
print('R7 PASS')
"
